title: 四级长对话：社区厨房与椅子维修
instruction: 听完整一节两段长对话及各段后读出的问题，依次选择最佳答案。音频中材料和问题各读一遍，卷面只印四个选项。本原创使用节内编号1—8，各段对应1—4、5—8题。播放器可回听，正式单次听辨条件未强制。
audio_introduction: Section B. You will hear two long conversations. After each, you will hear questions. Each recording and each question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer from A, B, C and D.
source_form_notice: 四级形式参照2024年12月第一套转载Section B：2段、4/4共8回应、每题四选；原创采用节内编号，问题只在录音与作者区。全部自有虚构内容及本机合成试听，非原考试原声；未独立教研/听辨/学生难度或产品等值验证。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I would like to use the community kitchen for a family baking afternoon. The calendar shows a free space on Sunday.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The room is available from two until five. That includes cleaning time, so all food preparation has to finish early enough for you to leave it clean by five.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I thought we could bake until five and wash everything afterwards. We had better begin at two, then. There will be eight of us.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Eight is within the room limit of ten. Someone in your group must have attended our kitchen introduction. It explains the equipment and what to do if something goes wrong.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: My cousin completed that last month. Does she have to stay for the whole session?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. Being available by telephone is not enough. She will be the responsible person while the kitchen is in use.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That is possible. Do you supply baking trays?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We have six medium trays, measuring scales and mixing bowls. Bring ingredients and containers for taking your baking home. We do not keep leftover food overnight.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Can the children use the large mixer?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Only the trained adult may operate that one. The children can mix by hand with an adult supervising. We will put a reminder beside the machine.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. I will tell everyone to bring a container and check that my cousin can stay until we finish cleaning.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then send the booking form with her name. You can pay after we confirm it.

questions.spoken_question: What must the group complete by five on Sunday?
options: Only the first batch of baking.
Both baking and cleaning the kitchen.
A telephone call to every participant.
questions.rationale: C房间二到五含清洁；A只烤不全，B介绍已有人完，D无电话要求。

questions.spoken_question: Why is the cousin’s presence important?
options: She has completed the introduction and must remain responsible.
She is the only person allowed to bring ingredients.
She needs to teach a public class that evening.
She owns the kitchen’s mixing bowls.
questions.rationale: A受训人在场全程；B食材任何人带，C无授课，D设备社区非她所有。

options: Six trays and a weighing scale.
Food to store overnight in the kitchen.
Ingredients and containers for taking food home.
questions.rationale: D材料与带走盒；A/B设备有，C不留食过夜。

questions.spoken_question: Who may operate the large mixer?
options: The trained adult responsible for the session.
Anyone who has paid the room fee.
Only a staff member from the booking office.
questions.rationale: Btrainedadult；A儿童只手拌，C付钱不代培训，D非限定office员工。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I brought in a wooden chair last week. You said you would call with a repair estimate, and I received a message this morning.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. One joint needs repairing, but the seat itself is sound. The estimate covers making the chair stable. It does not include changing the surface finish.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That is what I wanted to check. It belonged to my grandmother, and I would rather keep the worn paint than have it looking new.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can leave the paint alone. There is a small mark beside the joint that may remain visible after the repair. Removing it would mean treating a larger part of the surface.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Please leave that too. I care more about using the chair safely than making the colour even. How long will the work take?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The repair can be done by Friday, but the material must be allowed to set before the chair is used. We ask you not to collect it until Monday.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I am away on Monday and Tuesday. Could a friend collect it for me?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, if you give us the friend’s name in advance. They should bring the collection number from your receipt. We will not release it simply to someone who knows your name.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That seems sensible. I will send her name after I have asked her. Should I pay now?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A small deposit now, and the balance on collection. We will photograph the chair’s condition before starting and give you a copy with the receipt.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. Please go ahead with the joint repair and keep the old paint.

options: Repairing a joint to make the chair stable.
Removing all signs of age from the paint.
Delivering the chair to another country.
questions.rationale: B接缝稳定；Aseat sound，C不含finish，D无跨国送。

questions.spoken_question: What is the woman’s preference concerning the surface?
options: She wants the chair painted a completely new colour.
She wants the small mark removed at any cost.
She prefers to retain the worn paint and the mark.
She wants the repairer to decide without consulting her.
questions.rationale: C留旧漆与mark，A/B反，D她明确决定。

questions.spoken_question: Why is collection delayed until Monday?
options: The repair material needs time to set.
The chair will not reach the shop until Friday.
The owner must attend a training course.
The shop has lost the original seat.
questions.rationale: A星期五修好但须set，B上周已送，C无课，D座完好未失。

questions.spoken_question: What must happen before the friend can collect the chair?
options: The friend must repaint it in the shop.
The full estimate must be written again.
The owner must cancel the repair deposit.
The owner must supply the friend’s name in advance.
questions.rationale: D提前给友名且带号，A无漆/B非重写/C付押不退约。
